observations.p1b_result: Confirmed P1: backend sum covers the complete filtered domain, page_sum the current page, and monetary currency identity is validated over the complete flat/group domain and returned as currency_id. ListPage ignores that identity and formats flat/group footers from the first parent page row. No backend aggregation-algorithm gap is proven.
observations.p1b_contract_gap: The frontend transport type does not declare existing list aggregates or grouped aggregate payloads, so ListPage carries them as loose records. This is a frontend consumer schema gap.
observations.batch2_result: Confirmed F01: collection projection preserves only duration and drops percentage identity; List and One2many also use generic numeric formatting before the shared presenter. Confirmed F02: native field descriptors project digits only for monetary, form/list/One2many metadata consumes digits only for monetary, generic float display is fixed at two decimals, and percentage formatting hardcodes two decimal places.
observations.batch2_boundary: F02 requires a P0 float digits projection first; frontend-only precision guesses would violate the contract boundary.
